correctness.rationale: The cactus block-tree bijection between spanning trees and one omitted edge in each cycle is proved. Character orthogonality gives an exact product over cycles and bridges, permitting rank and sharp spectral-gap counts. The endpoint norm is the average absolute Fourier kernel, reducing to a telescoping binomial identity. Strictly decreasing successive central-binomial factor ratios prove all fixed-vertex extremal and equality claims. The checker independently enumerated 5,648 full Fourier coefficients and 5,739 possible cycle-length configurations, with all tests passing; universal claims follow from the written proof, not these finite checks.

value.rationale: Natural connected simple cacti have uniquely independent cycle blocks. The theorem gives a full harmonic operator classification on all these graphs: exactly which convolution operators are invertible, exact ranks and spectral gaps, sharp endpoint projection norms, and the unique extremal cycle-length patterns among all cactus graphs with fixed number of vertices or cycles. The triangle extremal theorem is a global structural optimization result and not merely a computed finite invariant.
